title: MooseMobs X Fresh Animations
description: This pack adds compatibility between MooseMobs and Fresh LX's Fresh Animations resource pack!
body:
### Moosified Mobs Made Fresh
If you're a fan of Fresh Animations like I am and were disappointed that my mobs pack doesn't support those amazing animations I have great news. By loading this pack above Fresh Animations you can have all the great features of FA with textures made by a Moose!
